'''Benish''' is from [[Tarabon]], who may have [[Malkier]]i blood.

== Appearance ==
Benish is a surly man who wears a Taraboner veil but also the ''[[Hadori]]''.

== Activities ==
Benish is one of [[Lan]]'s High Guard of Malkier as they retreat across [[Shienar]]. He helps take a wounded [[Andere]] back for Healing during one skirmish.

==Trivia==
*Benish is named after Paul Benish, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
